description: This header file declares functions for selecting a single group or instance based on specific criteria within the 'cuttlefish' project's selector module. It includes function prototypes for selecting groups and instances, referencing related classes and modules such as 'InstanceManager', 'CommandRequest', 'LocalInstance', and 'LocalInstanceGroup'.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Selects a single group based on the request's selector options, prompting the user if multiple groups match and stdin is a terminal.

methods.name: SelectInstance
methods.description: Selects a single instance based on the request's selector options; fails if multiple matches are found. Also returns the group the selected instance belongs to.
